notes.type_correctness: All TypeScript types are correct and consistent. useTheme exports Theme = 'light' | 'dark' and { theme, toggle } as specified. computePositions signature matches the delta-spec (W and H params). HeroMesh uses Record<string, never> which is equivalent to the proposal's {} constraint. No tsc errors.
notes.pattern_adherence: useTheme hook follows React hook patterns with useState lazy initializer and useEffect for side effects. HeroMesh correctly keeps all mutable state in refs/closures. Canvas lifecycle cleanup is complete (RAF cancel, IO disconnect, all event listeners removed). Minor: ThemeToggleBtn named differently from delta-spec's ThemeToggle — same behavior, internal only.
notes.test_coverage: All 5 new test files pass. useTheme has complete coverage of init, toggle, localStorage, and dataset. computePositions tests cover mutation-in-place, far-mouse (no distortion), near-mouse (depth) cases. AgentsSection tests verify intro copy, 3 Core badges, Developer and Reviewer note text. Index.test.tsx shows canvas getContext errors in jsdom (pre-existing issue, tests still pass).
notes.security: No XSS vectors — canvas drawing uses only numeric RGB values from CSS custom properties, no innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML. localStorage access is wrapped in try/catch. No user-provided strings are rendered into the DOM directly. SVG is inline with static fill values only (hsl(var(--foreground)), hsl(var(--background))). SECURITY_STATUS: CLEAN.
notes.architectural_alignment: HeroMesh is a single-purpose canvas component with zero React state — all mutable engine state in closure variables. computePositions is exported for testability as specified. The proposal's signature check (nodes, mouseX, mouseY, out) is satisfied — W and H are additional params documented in the delta-spec. AgentEntry extension with optional fields is backwards-compatible. No backend code added.
